prompt:
Design a 9 V nominal red indicator LED circuit targeting 4-5 mA, with exactly one series current-limiting resistor. Assume LED forward voltage 1.8-2.2 V. Required components: R1 resistor (pins A/B), D1 LED (pins A/K), VIN source port (pin 1), GND return port (pin 1), and OUT observation port (pin 1). Connect VIN through R1 to the LED anode; connect LED cathode to GND; OUT observes the LED anode node. Include all five components and assign every listed pin exactly once. Every net needs at least two terminal IDs; terminal IDs must be REF.pin, never a net name. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema.
Response schema: {"topology":"string","components":[{"ref":"string","kind":"resistor|capacitor|led|timer555|port|ground","value":"string or null","pins":["string"]}],"nets":[{"name":"string","terminals":["REF.pin"]}]}
